title: INFRA — PM2 process auto-healer — restart failed crons after 3 consecutive failures
description: Cron processes may fail silently. Auto-healer script runs every 5 min via PM2. It reads pm2 list --json, identifies processes with status=errored or unstable_restarts>=3 (within 10 min window), restarts them via pm2 restart, and sends Telegram alert with process name and restart count. Writes state to logs/healer-state.json.

tasks.title: Create scripts/scs001/pm2-auto-healer.ts — PM2 failure detector + restarter
tasks.description: execSync('pm2 jlist') to get JSON list. For each process: if status=errored OR unstable_restarts>=3: add to failing list. For each failing: execSync('pm2 restart NAME'). Send Telegram alert listing restarted processes. Write {timestamp, checked, restarted:[]} to logs/healer-state.json. Max 120 lines. No external deps.
